description: List, create, update, send, or delete drafts. On send, you can pass `wake` to limit which local recipients get a host turn — same semantics as send_email.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

wake.description: Optional, for action=send. Names of the agents who should get a host turn when the drafted mail lands. Pass `[]` to deliver silently. Omit to wake everyone CC'd.

name: manage_drafts
